description: Find and read code snippets with versioning support. Actions: list (personal/project/public scope with filtering), get (snippet metadata or raw file content). Related: manage_snippet to create/update.

created_after.description: Return snippets created after this date (ISO 8601). Example: '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z' Required for 'list' action(s).

created_before.description: Return snippets created before this date (ISO 8601). Example: '2024-12-31T23:59:59Z' Required for 'list' action(s).

id.description: The ID of the snippet to retrieve Required for 'get' action(s).

per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100) Required for 'list' action(s).

projectId.description: Project ID or URL-encoded path. Required for project snippets, leave empty for personal snippets

raw.description: Return raw content of snippet files instead of metadata Required for 'get' action(s).

scope.description: Scope of snippets: "personal" for current user, "project" for project-specific (requires projectId), "public" for all public snippets Required for 'list' action(s).

visibility.description: Filter by visibility: private (author only), internal (authenticated users), public (everyone) Required for 'list' action(s).

name: browse_snippets
